question: Which of the following countries is NOT part of the three nations to host the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Argentina**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The FIBA Basketball World Cup 2023 will take place in the **Philippines**, **Japan**, and **Indonesia **from **August 25** to **September 10**.
 
• The** 32 participating teams **will play in 92 games played over 16 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
